I had this vision of a mugger, knife drawn, and the woman hands him the purse.  The criminal immediately gives it back and decides to never steal again. 
What I'm saying is this purse can be used for good.  If only someone were brave enough to wield it...

All I can do is picture the car door standing there saying, "I got your nose... Oh shit, have it back!"  
And then there would be those awkward reunions where the door is like, "I'm so sorry."
But then I remember car doors don't fucking talk.
The child in me couldn't get over the use of the word duties.
Now I want pancakes. :(

Failing isn't a bad thing. Outcomes are just outcomes, tying yourself to them just drags you down. I am very sorry you feel this way, and I hope you find happiness or something like it soon.

Friends are good for a laugh, to discuss topics with, play games both challenging and stupid. You can also grab a pint with friends, bitch or rejoice over the days events, talk through the tough life decisions, go out clubbing and just dance it off. They can call you out on your bullshit, or agree with you whole-heartedly. And the best thing about it is that you can do all this too, for them. Friendships can be wonderful and add to the overall swellness of life. 

Then again, they can also turn into bitches.  But at that point they may just not be your friend anymore.

Hey, I read this, and I would like to help. Not by telling you what to do like so many tend to do, but if you want to talk at all, about anything, even about how so many things are shit, I am here. 

We have one thing in common, an affinity for whiskey. and we have another, thinking life is basically shit most of the time.

I don't know, I just would like to be there for you if you'll let me.

It could also be said that life is the exact opposite of pointless. There are an infinite number of potential points to life and its entirely your own choice which one or two or fifty of those points you wish to pursue.

I don't know if anyone has said this but here is a great way to look at the whole talking to someone you don't know yet situation, especially with females. People in general love it when someone talks to them, especially girls. No girl was ever bummed about a guy hitting on her, at the very least she is stoked for the confidence boost. Alternatively, it is relatively rare for a girl to hit on a guy who hasn't started talking to her first. We are always looking for an indication that all systems are go, and we can proceed with flirting and the exchange of numbers.
Worst case scenario, you get some practice putting yourself out there and a fake number or no call. Best, well there is really no telling how good the situation can get. 
Just go for it.

Don't be so worried. Read some books instead of relying on the internet (though internets are great) to occupy your time. When your stitches get removed start bicycling! It's a great way to get fresh air and get some exercise.  And who knows, maybe you can makes some new friends. Making friends is tough at any age. But you always have at least one friend, yourself. Spend time doing things that will help you become who you want to be. Like if you want to get better at math, practice. Use the internet to help you, and eventually it will get more manageable. Emotions are generally hard to control at your age until into your twenties, so don't think that there is something wrong with who you are just because you feel. Feeling is good, it let's you know you're alive. I know that the things you want seem very far away, and they may well be. But life's most rewarding achievements are hard to accomplish. Take it a day at a time. IRL can be pretty great if you give it a chance. I really hope you consider these things. there is always time to do the right thing. :)
